C0431.title: Gang Sentenced for Extortion After Fabricating Negative Publicity to Demand Deletion Fees
C0431.summary: In February 2026, a criminal gang posted negative articles targeting companies to create public opinion pressure, then demanded protection fees and cooperation fees in exchange for deleting the content. Through online harassment, they extorted over 1.8 million yuan from businesses, and multiple individuals involved were convicted and sentenced.
